method.thresholds_status: U rule of thumb (spec B5.1), not tuned; identical to backend/field (imported from fieldshift_field.detector)

sources.title: HLS v2.0 HLSL30/HLSS30, NASA/USGS (NASA LP DAAC, Earthdata login)

notes: HLS is NASA's harmonized Landsat 8/9 + Sentinel-2 surface reflectance at 30 m; same thresholds as the Sentinel-2/Landsat calendar, so the two calendars differ only by input data.
Days after the last clear HLS scene are 'unknown' (not extrapolated).
